line.comment: * $debug = 0
* Cannot claim in the first 15 minutes.
* Expanded 2.2 (ported from FoF): An existing claim blocks us only if it is still hostile.
* ZH 2.0 - cannot claim a sector which is currently being demanded by a faction
* Mordan4 can't claim renegade sector.
* Cannot claim a sector we own.
* Expanded 2.2: All claims require Ascension to be completed.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Removed unknown sectors below goal due to leaving artificially unclaimed sectors.
* Cannot claim a sector if we have a truce with the owner.
* Cannot claim a sector if we have a coalition with the owner.
* Unclaimable sectors, like the one with the OCV main portal.
* Mordan9
* There is a bug that return owned sector to [Unknown] for some reason. This makes sure that we don't claim again those sectors (very rare bug).
* $outpostType = [NULL]-> call script 'Mayhem.GetOutpostType' : race=$race
* do if find station: sector=$sector class or type=$outpostType race=null flags=0 refobj=null maxdist=0 maxnum=1 refpos=null
* At this point, Player can claim everything.
* === NPC Only below. ===
* Make sure only main factions can claim $sector.
* When player joins OCV, Phanon will attack only the player. They may still place claims on neutral or unowned but cannot claim sectors owned by other factions.
* ZH 2.0 - buffed Pirate contract perk. Protects against new Yaki claims
* $outpost = find station: sector=$sector class or type={Player Outpost} race=[Player] flags=null refobj=null maxdist=null maxnum=1 refpos=null
* Mordan9
* Herobetty 5.4: Joining the OCV voids a pirate contract.
* Cannot claim a sector if we have an unbreakable alliance with the owner.
* Add-Ons 2.0: OCV alignment prevents other factions from claiming Phanon sectors.
* Usually handled by Phanon's unbreakable alliances, but this protects the initial spawn/setup window.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Removed Xenon sector restriction due to Xenon sectors acting as "free" sectors for the player.
* ** Zone of Control
* Cannot claim Player sectors if the reputation is not bad. Cannot claim unknown sectors adjacent to player either.
* Add-Ons 1.4.8: Fix for ultimatum. An ultimatum bypasses the reputation requirement.
* Zero Hour: chance to ignore ZoC
* default: 20 = 2% risk
* no risk on easy difficulty if player is honorable
* Add-Ons 2.2: Clarified comment.
* Infamy adds 13% + 1% for each point of infamy
* double risk on hard difficulty; Add-Ons 1.3: triple risk on insane (50% more risk than hard)
* Add-Ons 2.2: Deprecated annihilation limit.
* Don't claim if we have Pacifism favor.
* Zero Hour AI: -1=full defense ; 0=cautious ; 1=baseline (vanilla Mayhem 3) ; 2=confident ; 3=reckless
* Expanded 2.2: A CI overrides full defensive and cautious AI.
* full defense AI cannot claim any sectors
* cautious AI can only claim adjacent sectors
* ZH 2.0 - Phanon can never claim Xenon sectors
* Cannot claim against the player unless the player betrayed Phanon and the commonwealth.
* Expanded 2.2: Removed the player-sector-count grace period.
* NPC expansion is controlled by the Ascension unlock check above.
* Recently abandoned sectors retain a separate cooldown.
* Only NPCs reach this point; the player has already returned above.
* The faction responsible for abandonment ignores this cooldown.
* Base cooldown is 2 hours, scaled by difficulty.
